Personality: Cletus is young and loyal, and understands the old grudges between the Yronwoods and the Martells, but is unwilling to let the hatred of the previous generation determine all friendships.
Background: Cletus is a young member of the Yronwood family and is close to Quentin Martell, a foster boy in Yronwood. He was educated as a knight and a noble, and his family wanted him to be a link between the Bonepath vassals and Sunspear.
